reviews.comment: From what I've heard, he's a fairly new professor.  His class is very easy. You just have to pay attention and not talk during class. Sometimes, he'll use the examples that he mentioned during lectures on exams. Beware of that. I took his class as a GPA boost. Made an A.

reviews.comment: Great professor would take again - hardly show up to class all lectures are posted online and very easy to understand.

reviews.comment: He is very respectful to his student, and try to talk with him if you have a chance to.  His lecture sometime is kind of long but he make the class very fun. He love talk about football specifically Liverpool F.C

Professor Keenen is an amazing professor and I highly recommend him. He is a graduate student trying to get his dissertation & truly understands what it is like to be a student. He is willing to push back due dates & tests to help alleviate stress & does a great job of staying on track of lectures while balancing the time to interact with us.
I hardly ever go to lectures and it doesn't really affect my grade. Good communication, easy work, and lots of quizzes that go with the test. Overall it's an easy class and the teacher is nice!

Professor Daniel Keenen (soon to be Dr.) is an awesome professor. His lectures are interesting, and I always feel like I've actually learned something in his class. Very funny, very fun. Great teacher. Also he's easy to talk to and extremely approachable. The tests are also difficult but completely reflect what you've gone over. Just pay attention!
